rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved or accredited by a state board of nursing, state nurses association or national body such as ANCC; MEDCEU hours not accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours are prorated by month of licensure (board CE proration chart); newly licensed nurses must complete the 4-hour Board-provided Mandatory course.

topics.who: newly licensed nurses (by exam or endorsement)

rules.notes: Single-state RN licenses renew Sept 1-Dec 31 of even years; multistate RN licenses renew in odd years. Fee shown is single-state ($100 + $4.50 transaction fee); multistate is $204.50. CE from Board-approved providers is posted to the nurse's CE record in My Profile.
